arbiter: the canonical ten-gate policy, and nothing else. This searcher discovers and reports; it sets no threshold of its own. Pipeline: discovery -> backtest -> ten gates -> certificate -> forward window -> live.

honesty.why: every (feature, band, horizon, direction) combination evaluated is counted and carried into each hypothesis, so deflated Sharpe deflates against the real multiplicity of the search rather than a flattering subset
honesty.oos_only: scored on the held-out 40% only; band edges derived from the fit window so the condition itself does not leak
honesty.selection: greedy on marginal independence, |corr| < 0.5 against everything already chosen -- diversity is the objective, not a filter
